question: Can a tensor no stiffer than the saved parent satisfy all24 retained reference targets?
test: For each fixed candidate C and reference M, compute min eigenvalue of (C-M)v=lambda Mv. For any X<=C, its worst model disagreement is at least max(0,-lambda_min). Take maximum over all24 references and replay the witness Rayleigh quotient.
scope: Necessary conditional algebraic test for stiffness-decreasing corrections; a floor above1% obstructs that class for the recorded matrix. A floor below1% is not a feasibility or attainable-FE proof. Changed physical domains are not constrained by this test.
cases: All four saved dashboard lattice tensors and the independently audited complete enriched diagnostic under its recorded integration rules
controls: Too-stiff, too-soft and mixed diagonal matrices; nonorthogonal basis invariance; below-target control
limits: 60seconds,8GiB,one numerical thread, no mesh/field/model changes, no FE solve or promoted reference
